direction.name: 연속 사진 편집
direction.concept: Use closely related views of the complete lamp and its light falling across a real open book as a photographic editorial sequence. The sequence itself organises the whole composition; not an empty room backdrop.
direction.image_grammar: Natural photographic depth, distinct whole-product and illuminated-page crops joined through a clear editing seam; no copied film frames. Product complete in one view with the reference geometry/color.
direction.body_flow: A lamp/light contact point leads into the two description sentences adjacent to the image seam. Keep those sentences continuous in a comfortably readable column. Continue from that column into an adjoining event/date/place group then visit/invitation/URL; related information shares optical starts and predictable spacing. The title labels the visual story and does not consume body area.
direction.type: Mature low-contrast Korean/Latin sans body, uniform glyph proportions/open counters, balanced numerals, moderate weight, semantic wrapping and calm consistent leading. Headline can have stronger optical mass without scaling that styling down into body.
direction.distinctness: Image sequence and an editorial seam organise reading, rather than an ink silhouette/diagram/painted still life or luminous abstraction.

common_constraints: Prioritize the concrete positive first-generation design and naturally connected body copy. Print full copy once in the native tool brief, no rubric or plan dump.
The current user request and exact product fixture are authoritative; implementation guidance is not an invented client-fixed coordinate/grid/font condition.
Use collected ideas; do not browse source websites or re-open studio/Canva originals for this request. Only the exact supplied lamp fixture is a mandatory viewed/native reference.
Five different whole styles; no common info panel, font or title-first layout added.
Do not read peer production or external quality feedback. Close own selection before independent evaluation.

assets.kind: synthetic product photograph-style fixture, not real client photograph or a poster

source_digest.case_entry_digest_method: UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, no extra whitespace

input_scope: One literal case/common input and one own role/direction; no corpus policies, peer plan or evaluation history.
